_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-2 inputs. Read by F16GeomL2, F16AeroL2, F16PropL2, F16WeightsL2. Full docs: F16GeomL2.md, F16AeroL2.md, F16PropL2.md, F16WeightsL2.md, docs/*_parameter_usage.md; open items in VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md.
_cite: Main!/Engn(s)!/Miss!/Wt! = Brandt-F16-A.xls tabs; TO = T.O. 1F-16A-1; Raymer = Raymer 6th ed.; Mattingly = Mattingly AED 2nd ed.; todo = VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md.

geometry._src: Surface geometry = Brandt Main tab, column B (wing) / C (horizontal_tail) / H (vertical_tail), rows 18 = S_ft2, 19 = AR, 20 = taper, 21 = sweep_LE_deg, 22 = NACA 4-digit (last 2 digits = t/c %; wing B22 = 1404 -> 4%, corroborated TO Fig. 1-2 NACA 64A204). tc_root, tc_tip [TO Sec. I biconvex]. fuselage length_ft, max_width_ft, max_height_ft [Main!B32/C32/D32]. engine duct_length_ft [Main!F32, label E32 'Compr Face'].
geometry._note: Row map also in F16GeomL2.md / F16GeomL3.md §F. Derived quantities are Dependent getters; engine SLS thrust arrives by DI from .propulsion.T_SL.
geometry._overall_length_ft_src: L_aircraft, ft; feeds only the Raymer Eq. 12.44 (Amax/l)^2 term. Published F-16A length 47 ft 7.75 in = 47.6458 ft. Distinct from fuselage.length_ft.
geometry._TODO_overall_length_ft: overall_length_ft = 47.65 is traceable to no document in this repo; remove this key when pinned to a primary source. todo 2026-07-25 Phase 2 §6; Geom!B21 does not pin it (F16GeomL3.md §E).

aerodynamics._src: Cfe_subsonic_clean [Raymer Tbl 12.3 AF fighter, for Eq. 12.23]; e_method 'official' [Raymer Eq. 12.48/12.49]; airfoil name [TO Fig. 1-2]; airfoiltype, design_CL [NACA 64A204 section data]; alpha_L0_deg, cl_max_2D, cl_alpha_per_deg [unpinned, see _TODO keys]

airfoil.name: NACA 64A204
airfoil._TODO_alpha_L0_deg: alpha_L0 = -1.01 unverified against a primary NACA 64A204 source (thin-airfoil band -1.4 to -1.9); remove when pinned. Guard: TestAeroL2.testTODO_AlphaL0Unverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_max_2D: cl_max_2D = 1.20 (Abbott & von Doenhoff) conflicts with NTRS-19870017427's 1.0; remove when reconciled. Guard: TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClMax2DUnverified.
airfoil._TODO_cl_alpha_per_deg: cl_alpha = 0.105/deg is an internet-band midpoint, not primary-sourced; remove when pinned. Guard: TestAeroL2.testTODO_ClAlpha2DUnverified.

propulsion._src: engine_type [F100-PW-200 class; selects the PropL2 Mattingly Eq. 3.55a/b TSFC coefficients]; engine_model [descriptor]; T_SL = T_SL_wet, AB SLS lbf [Engn(s)!T_AB_SLS = Main!D29; TO Sec. I]; T_SL_mil, dry SLS lbf [Engn(s)!T_mil_SLS = Main!C29]; T_t4_max_F [Mattingly Tbl C.4, F100-PW-100]; TSFC_install_factor [Miss!C25 = Main!C25]
propulsion._note: Installed = uninstalled x 1.08. Brandt's stored SLS TSFCs (0.70 mil / 2.20 AB) are ALREADY installed -- do not double-apply [todo 2026-07-24 §4]. TR [Mattingly Eq. D.6] is derived.

weights._src: aircraft_category [selects Raymer Tbl 15.2 fighter psf + AE481 metabook §7 fractions; both toolbox Constants]; N_en [TO]; W_en [estimate, unpinned]; W_energy [Wt!B6]; W_payload_fixed [estimate, unpinned]; W_payload_expendable [WeightsBase contract]
weights._note: Exposed and fuselage wetted areas are injected live from F16GeomL2, not stored here. LG fraction 0.033 vs Brandt 0.034: todo 2026-07-24 §3c item 2.
